channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-datascience
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: YYLO Ledger — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Command-line task and workflow ledger for coding-agent projects: stores the Kanban board and task state as hash-chained Markdown inside the repository, tracks receipts and archives, and drives typed merge and release flows across agent worktrees. MIT licensed.

item.title: US Tariff Data — via awesome-datascience
item.description: The US Harmonized Tariff Schedule (about 30,000 lines with rates), chapter 99 additional duties by country (Section 301, 232 and others) and EU import duties by HS subheading and origin, refreshed with each HTS revision. CSV and JSON, no login, CC0 (US data) and OGL v3 (EU data), Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23093989.

item.title: US Provider Industry Payments — via awesome-datascience
item.description: 1.65M US healthcare providers joined by NPI to the drug and device company payments reported to them in CMS Open Payments (2019-2025): total, payment count, largest payer and payment type, with state and specialty rollups. Gzipped CSV, no login, CC0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23098004.

item.title: YYLO — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Open-source command-line orchestrator for coding agents and repeatable workflows, with typed task, validation, merge, and release-readiness boundaries and receipt-backed repository changes. MIT licensed, installable via npm.

item.title: Awesome Python Math Packages — via awesome-datascience
item.description: A curated list of Python packages for mathematics, from linear algebra and optimization to statistics and topology.

item.title: YYLO Benchmark — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Open-source trusted-host experiment runner for historical agent tasks, supplied coding prompts, and workflows. Runs independent attempts with retained outputs, and compares models, harnesses, and configurations with different checks or judges later. MIT licensed.

item.title: Synthetic Hospital — via awesome-datascience
item.description: A Medical Benchmark & EHR Simulation Platform

item.title: Jev Social — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Read-only social research agent that lets Jev choose bounded Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn operations, runs them through the local socai CLI in Chrome, and preserves source-linked evidence beside a cited report.

item.title: QuiddityML — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Short lessons with hands-on coding exercises and spaced repetition, covering Python, PyTorch, math for ML, ML foundations, NLP, and computer vision.

item.title: OpenLanguageModel — via awesome-datascience
item.description: PyTorch-native library for building, training and teaching transformer language models, with architectures written as ordinary nn.Modules.

item.title: WhatFontIs-Bench — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Synthetic benchmark for font family identification with 11,995 images of words set in 600 known fonts, annotated with word and per-letter boxes.

item.title: TorchDR — via awesome-datascience
item.description: GPU and multi-GPU dimensionality reduction with a scikit-learn-compatible API.

item.title: PhilanthroPy — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Scikit-learn native toolkit for nonprofit fundraising analytics: leakage-safe donor propensity, lapse, planned-giving, wealth-screening and revenue-forecasting estimators.

item.title: Kitaru — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Open-source platform that records real AI agent runs, replays them against changes, and evaluates outcomes before deployment.

item.title: Great Learning Data Science Programs — via awesome-datascience
item.description: A collection of online data science and analytics certificate, postgraduate, and degree programs.

item.title: AI Talks — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Searchable summaries and topic index for practical AI engineering talks and conference videos.

item.title: Pokemon Card Sold-Price Reference by Grade — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Median sold price by grade (raw, PSA 9, PSA 10) for 486 Pokemon cards, with sample size and confidence flag per card. CSV, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI.

item.title: Pokemon Card Centering Measurements — via awesome-datascience
item.description: 320 measured PSA-style centering annotations (left/right and top/bottom border percentages, tilt) across 302 real eBay-listed Pokemon cards. CSV, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI.

item.title: Evidaxis Momentum Snapshots — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Weekly snapshots of public development and citation activity for open-source and research-native AI systems, content-addressed and byte-reproducible from public inputs. JSON and CSV per snapshot date, CC0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21076011.

item.title: me_fasttext — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Memory-efficient FastText variant with exact trie n-gram IDs, structure-aware row sharing, and mmap serving for large-vocabulary NLP.

item.title: FlexViz — via awesome-datascience
item.description: Python library for interactive, cross-filtered dashboards that stay responsive on 100M+ rows by aggregating with Polars on the server.
